desc: Build and statically preflight separate exact J614s right-HPM2 SPMI candidates for policy classes R0/R1/R2. Start from reviewed upstream Gen3 transport plus yuka dcc5f1bc only as source material; fix NULL/lifetime/bounds/reporting bugs and every unbounded FIFO/selector/command poll. Hard-code direct ADT-verified /arm-io/nub-spmi-a1/hpm2 matching (Gen3, reg0 0x309198000, sole child, SN201202x, SID 0x0c, rid2, right); never iterate buses/HPMs/SIDs. R0 only selector+one-byte logical 0x20 read; R1 adds separately built WAKEUP and conditional SSPS S0; R2 separately saves/restores exact IRQ mask without all-ones W1C clear. Each artifact must hard-stop before the next class, log every transaction, build twice byte-identically, pin hashes, and receive independent review. Offline only; no rig.
